text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Rulership—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Out of the question, Trainer. We're 
taking a detour. There's no way we're 
pushing through that chaotic crowd."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Fretting over the unpredictable 
movements of the crowd wears on the 
nerves, and the sheer pressure causes 
pointless fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Just imagining going in there... ugh!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're just as bad with crowds as you were 
when you were little, Ruler.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Geh, Air Groove-san! Um—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...You don't look so good.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Actually, my mother hasn't been 
feeling well. I'm on my way to buy a 
get-well gift for her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She put on a brave face over the phone— 
but she has a slight fever and only ate 
half her usual meal! I need to bring her 
something easy to eat right away.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I-I see. Well, that certainly... is a 
concern.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Then I will accompany you. Your mother... 
Sensei, took great care of me, after all.
choice_data_list: If I'm not intruding, that is.
If I wouldn't be in the way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sales floor we arrived at was 
abnormally hot. It wasn't an air 
conditioning failure, but rather the sheer 
overwhelming heat of the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Gweh... Wh-What is this crowd?! There's 
literally zero space between people...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is a super popular area, after all... 
However, Mother's favorite jelly is just 
up ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, even if only one of us breaks 
through, we'll claim it. I'm counting on 
you two!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... D-Don't push...! 
Fgununununu!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It hurts... I can't breathe...! Isn't this 
basically a punishment game...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Endure it... I'm moving forward, little 
by little...! Ugh...?!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I-It's impossible~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Strategic retreat, 
successful. Let's wish those two the best 
of luck...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Hm?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Here, a present for you! Isn't this 
sticker cute?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
How about sticking them on the calendar? 
You can put one on every day you work hard 
at the racing club!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that sounds fun! I'm gonna stick on a 
whole bunch~~♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh... How heartwarming—

text_block_list.name: Young Ruler
text_block_list.text:
Direct attack on Teacher! With this, your 
life points hit zero... I win!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did I lose? Ruler-chan, you're way too 
strong~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
With brains like this, making a huge 
splash in races is a sure thing! Hehe, I 
have high hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Young Ruler
text_block_list.text:
Yes, naturally it would! Hehe. Please help 
me with training today as well!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer-sensei used to... play with me a 
lot before training. Looking back, I 
wonder if it was all to keep my motivation 
up.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, I was just constantly 
relying on others. Right up until I left 
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Kuuu, nwoooaaahhh! Push through the crowd, 
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I can't move...! Mother... the jelly...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Please make an opening somehow. I'll 
charge right through it...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ruler...! Are you okay with these crowds!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Of course it's not okay...! Ah~ I've hit 
my limit, no way, no way, *urp*...!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Hey!? Don't push yourself, you fool!!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So many people gathered indoors... Ugh. 
Why can't everyone just shop online...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Almost there!? ...Damn it, 
there's still a long way to go! Geesh~~!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, anyway... jelly, I need jelly!! 
Waaahhh, jelly jelly jelllyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you're back. Now I can help 
Mother rest.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha, though I almost ended up being the 
one in need of a hospital visit myself.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha, though I almost ended up being the 
one in need of a hospital visit myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you truly were the star of the show 
this time. Mother will surely be delighted 
when she hears.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds nice. Wouldn't that bring 
them so much joy they'd cheer right up?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well... please tell them to take good care 
of themselves.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine now. Once we're out of the 
crowd, we're in the clear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. Judging by today's results, you 
seem to be making solid progress.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Sensei would surely be surprised if they 
saw me now. Heh heh, I can't wait."
